title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Implementing the Review Opinions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and Further Improving the Enforcement Work of the People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Earnestly Implementing the Deliberation Opinions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and Further Improving the Enforcement Work of the People's Courts

Fa [2009] No. 417

To: All High People's Courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

On October 29, 2009, the 11th Session of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress heard and deliberated the Report on Strengthening Civil Enforcement Work, Upholding Legal Authority and Ensuring Judicial Justice submitted by President Wang Shengjun of the Supreme People's Court. The committee members and deputies highly appraised President Wang Shengjun's report, stating that the report presented achievements realistically, analyzed issues profoundly and thoroughly, and put forward practical measures for strengthening and improving work. Committee members and deputies generally recognized that, in recent years, people's courts at all levels across the country have earnestly implemented the central authorities' directives, consciously accepted supervision by the people's congresses, effectively strengthened enforcement teams and enforcement systems, adopted forceful measures to intensify enforcement efforts, carried out large-scale concentrated clearance of backlogged enforcement cases, and achieved remarkable results in enforcement work. However, the issue of "difficulty in enforcement" has not yet been fundamentally resolved, and the tasks facing enforcement work have become even more arduous. During the deliberation, committee members and deputies also put forward specific opinions and suggestions on strengthening enforcement team building, improving the standardization of enforcement work, perfecting the work pattern of comprehensive governance of enforcement difficulties, advancing the construction of a social credit system, increasing enforcement assistance, and improving enforcement statistics.

Pursuant to the deliberation opinions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress and the discussions among committee members and deputies, and upon research by the Party Leadership Group of the Supreme People's Court, the following notice is hereby issued on further improving enforcement work for the current period and the future:

1. Rigorously enforce standardized enforcement. Courts at all levels shall take the standardized construction of enforcement work as the theme of work for the current period and the future, and comprehensively improve the level of standardization in enforcement work. First, make great efforts and adopt effective measures to resolve issues of disorder in enforcement, such as sealing, seizure, and freezing; appraisal and auction; suspension of enforcement; and seizure of property of persons other than the parties. Second, strictly apply the systems of enforcement objections and reconsideration. Where a party raises an objection or seeks reconsideration regarding an enforcement act in accordance with law, handle it properly in accordance with law, and effectively safeguard the parties' rights to remedial measures such as the right to object and the right to reconsideration. Third, focus on resolving issues of passive enforcement and delayed enforcement, and improve the flow management system for enforcement cases. Where parties report problems such as ineffective enforcement, passive enforcement, or delayed enforcement, promptly verify and handle them. Fourth, focus on resolving issues in entrusted enforcement, further improve relevant systems for entrusted enforcement; simplify procedures for entrusted enforcement, reducing the links in entrusted enforcement; strengthen internal supervision and management, establish a special registration system for entrusted enforcement cases, incorporate entrusted cases into the court's own case flow management and unified target assessment, strengthen the reminder and supervision systems for entrusted enforcement, and strictly implement the accountability system. In 2010, the Supreme People's Court will launch a special clearance campaign for entrusted enforcement cases across the national court system, effectively resolving the backlog of entrusted enforcement cases. Fifth, in response to the widespread problem of evading enforcement, explore countermeasures against evasion of enforcement, establish and improve a countermeasure mechanism against evasion of enforcement, further consolidate consensus, broaden thinking, and promote the resolution of enforcement difficulties. Sixth, further strengthen enforcement transparency, effectively utilize the "National Court Enforcement Case Information Management System" to disclose information such as the enforcement process, enforcement measures, and enforcement results, effectively protect the parties' rights to know, to participate, and to supervise, promote fairness through transparency, and establish public trust through fairness. Seventh, research and design a more scientific and reasonable statistical system for enforcement cases, refine indicators such as the actual enforcement rate and the method of case conclusion, and truly reflect the actual situation of enforcement work. Eighth, strengthen investigation and research, systematically review key links and aspects of enforcement work, as well as new situations and problems arising in enforcement practice, and introduce judicial interpretations and relevant systems in a planned and step-by-step manner, establishing and improving a long-term mechanism for enforcement work.

2. Step up enforcement efforts. First, on the basis of the concentrated clearance of backlogged enforcement cases in 2009, continue to carry out clearance activities, striving to substantially resolve the backlog of enforcement cases within one to two years. Second, fully and properly utilize the enforcement systems and measures provided for by current laws. Accurately apply the system of applying to the people's court at the next higher level for enforcement, and effectively overcome various forms of illegal interference through measures such as changing the enforcement court in accordance with law. Make full use of compulsory measures and means such as fines and detention to compel the person subject to enforcement to fulfill the obligations specified in the legal instrument. Further explore the application of methods such as recording the person subject to enforcement's failure to perform obligations in the credit reporting system, restricting the person subject to enforcement from leaving the country, restricting high consumption, entrusting lawyers with investigation, compulsory auditing, and public security organs assisting in investigation, so as to maximize the effectiveness of realizing claims. Third, strengthen the application of the system of reporting property by the person subject to enforcement and the measures restricting high consumption, so as to improve the effectiveness of property investigation. By implementing the amended decision of the Civil Procedure Law and the forthcoming judicial interpretation on restricting high consumption, require courts at all levels to increase the application of the property reporting system and high-consumption restriction measures, striving to promptly and comprehensively ascertain the property available for enforcement of the person subject to enforcement. Fourth, strengthen supervision over cross-regional enforcement cases, fully utilize means such as supervision enforcement, elevation of enforcement level, designation of enforcement, and listed supervision to eliminate interference from factors such as local and departmental protectionism. Fifth, establish and improve a rapid response mechanism for enforcement. Further leverage the role of enforcement command centers in high people's courts, intermediate people's courts, and grassroots people's courts; strengthen contacts with public security, procuratorial, and other departments; assemble rapid response forces; and strive to improve the rapid response capability of enforcement work, promptly handling enforcement leads and emergencies.

3. Rigorously enforce the building of enforcement teams. Take team building as the top priority in self-construction, strengthen education on ideals and beliefs, and firmly establish correct views on power, position, and interests. Strengthen education on the socialist rule of law concept, consciously arm the mind and guide practice with the socialist rule of law concept. Effectively improve work style, resolutely avoid simple and crude work methods and attitudes, perfunctory handling, and passing the buck, and establish a new image of being close to the people, civilized, responsible, pragmatic, fair, efficient, and incorruptible. Effectively strengthen the judicial capacity building of enforcement teams, formulate special training plans, provide systematic training for enforcement personnel, especially those in grassroots courts, vigorously improve the professional competence of enforcement personnel and their ability to skillfully do mass work and properly resolve conflicts and disputes, and comprehensively enhance the law enforcement level of enforcement teams. Place the construction of anti-corruption and integrity promotion in a prominent position to grasp and implement well, focusing on resolving issues such as bending the law for personal gain, dereliction of duty, trading power for money, uncivilized enforcement, and non-standard enforcement. Strengthen supervision over key links such as property preservation, sealing/seizure/freezing, auction, fines, and detention; continue to promote the practice of establishing integrity supervisors in enforcement departments; and strengthen direct and timely supervision of enforcement acts. Smooth the channels for the masses to report, tip off, and accuse enforcement personnel of illegal or disciplinary violations, and intensify the investigation and punishment of such violations. Further optimize the structure of enforcement teams, and promote the professionalization of enforcement personnel in accordance with the soon-to-be-issued and implemented "Regulations on Enforcement Officers of the People's Courts".

4. Rigorously enforce enforcement-related petitions and complaints. To properly handle enforcement-related petitions and complaints, the focus is to establish a complete set of enforcement petition work mechanisms from a systemic perspective, based on the principle of territorial management and graded responsibility: Improve the handling mechanism for enforcement petitions, unify the competent department for enforcement petitions, clearly define the work responsibilities of enforcement organs and specialized petition departments, and establish standing bodies and personnel for enforcement petitions as needed. Standardize the processing procedures for enforcement petition cases, and fully leverage the role of the petition termination mechanism for cases involving law and litigation under the leadership of the Party committee. Strengthen the supervision mechanism for enforcement petitions, striving to ensure that petition issues are genuinely resolved. Establish a responsibility mechanism for enforcement petitions, overcoming the phenomenon of only accepting but not handling or passing the buck. Improve the evaluation mechanism for enforcement petitions, and establish a verification system with the volume of petitions and the degree of resolution of petition issues as the main indicators. Explore a system of retrospective responsibility investigation for enforcement petitions, and strictly pursue Party discipline and administrative discipline responsibilities against relevant personnel who cause petitions due to illegal enforcement, passive enforcement, dereliction of duty, or malfeasance.

5. Rigorously enforce the optimization of the enforcement environment. Closely rely on the Party committee to coordinate and resolve difficulties and problems encountered in enforcement work; incorporate court enforcement work into the scope of assessment of target responsibilities for comprehensive social security governance; strengthen the assistance and cooperation of relevant departments in enforcement work through multiple methods and channels, effectively forming a joint force in comprehensive social governance of enforcement difficulties. Currently, focus on promoting the establishment and improvement of the enforcement coordination mechanism; actively strengthen communication and coordination with relevant departments; strive to forward documents for establishing the enforcement coordination mechanism in the form of resolutions of provincial people's congresses or documents of the provincial "Two Offices" (General Office of the Provincial Party Committee and General Office of the Provincial Government); by formulating implementing rules for the enforcement coordination mechanism, further clarify the statutory duties of relevant departments in assisting enforcement; intensify the investigation and punishment of acts of interference, evasion, and resistance to enforcement; simplify the working procedures for assisting enforcement; improve the efficiency of assisting enforcement; promptly circulate criticism of units that intentionally delay or evade the obligation to assist enforcement by their competent departments; where refusal to assist enforcement or abuse of authority by state organ personnel obstructs enforcement resulting in an inability to enforce, pursue administrative or criminal liability against the directly responsible persons and responsible supervisors in accordance with law. Further improve the conditions and procedures for enforcement coordination, and establish a complete set of highly operable operational and management mechanisms so that the enforcement coordination mechanism can play its role effectively. In response to the problem of an imperfect credit system, actively promote the establishment and improvement of the social credit system, creating a favorable institutional environment for enforcement work.

December 30, 2009
